tables.sectionText:
PRIZES AND ODDS

Match the winning number and win the prize1 amount selected at the beginning of the hourly drawing2. Multiply your prize amount by increasing your wager to $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play.

One To Win Prizes	Odds
$250	1 in 4,200
$100	1 in 2,100
$50	1 in 840
$20	1 in 210
$10	1 in 117
$7	1 in 44
$5	1 in 35



The overall odds of winning a prize is 1 in 15. Prize amounts are based on $1.00 base game wager.

DISCLAIMERS:

1 Prizes would be pari-mutuel when the total prize amount won for a $250 prize draw is above $200,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded
down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

2 One to Win can be played seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:45 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:44:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase One to Win tickets. The last drawing for One to Win will be each day at 11:45 PM Arizona time.

3 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
ONE TO WIN
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the number for you, or select your own number:

 One number (1 – 15)

Select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Quick Draw tickets start at $1 per game and can be purchased2 at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the number on your ticket to the winning number3 selected.
